mainEntity.name: What is the average Florida insurance agent's salary?

acceptedAnswer.text: In Florida, an insurance agent can expect to make an annual income of $67,261.

mainEntity.name: Which Florida city has the highest number of jobs?

acceptedAnswer.text: Tampa is without a doubt one of Florida’s greatest cities for work. In fact, Tampa was placed among the top 150 American cities for both its employment market and socioeconomic climate.

mainEntity.name: What does the average person make in Georgia?

acceptedAnswer.text: The average yearly salary for Georgia’s average jobs in insurance as of June 23, 2022, is $51,568. That comes out to be roughly $24.79 per hour.

mainEntity.name: Are Georgia-based agents welcome to add their listing to Agency Height's directory?

acceptedAnswer.text: Agencies and agents from all 50 states in the United States are welcome to add their listings to Agency Height’s directory. Our services are available to all.

mainEntity.name: What is the annual salary of a Texas-licensed insurance agent?

acceptedAnswer.text: In Texas, an insurance agent can expect to make an annual income of $69,830.

mainEntity.name: Which Jobs in Texas Have the Fastest Growth?

acceptedAnswer.text: The demand for several of Texas’s fastest-growing professions has outstripped the local supply, according to the Texas Workforce Commission (TWC). Operations research analysts, physician assistants, dental hygienists and assistants, market research analysts and experts, insurance agents, and software developers are some of the professions in Texas with the fastest growth rates.
